criteria.text: Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Marlow Industries Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.2 is stated as $27,000,000 but 10% of the $225,000,000 Purchase Price is $22,500,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $225,000,000 = $22,500,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $27,000,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
